description: This file defines the public API for the TR-069 Device.MoCA.Interface.QoS.FlowStats object, including a class MoCAInterfaceQoSFlowStats with getter methods for flow statistics parameters related to MoCA QoS flows.

classes.name: MoCAInterfaceQoSFlowStats
classes.description: A singleton class providing getter methods for flow statistics parameters of MoCA QoS flows.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MoCAInterfaceQoSFlowStats.

methods.name: get_FlowID
methods.description: Retrieves the FlowID used to identify a flow in the network.

methods.name: get_PacketDA
methods.description: Retrieves the Destination Address (DA) for packets in the flow.

methods.name: get_MaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum required rate in Kbps.

methods.name: get_MaxBurstSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum burst size of the MoCA interface.

methods.name: get_LeaseTime
methods.description: Retrieves the lease time (seconds) for the flow.

methods.name: get_LeaseTimeLeft
methods.description: Retrieves the remaining lease time (seconds) for the flow.

methods.name: get_FlowPackets
methods.description: Retrieves the number of packets transmitted for the flow.
